attractions.description: Columbus Zoo and Zoombezi Bay A world-class zoo with 7,000+ animals paired with Central Ohio's premier waterpark, where admission supports wildlife conservation.

attractions.description: CoSI (Center of Science and Industry) Award-winning science museum with 300+ hands-on exhibits, a planetarium, and live shows. Has been voted #1 in the nation six times.

attractions.description: Columbus Museum of Art Downtown art museum founded in 1878, showcasing American and European modern art, photography, and works by beloved local artists.
